reserveReview.rationale: Deloitte's unmodified AICPA examination signed October 26, 2026 covers September 21 and September 30, 2026 at 5:00pm Eastern Time. The rendered page 5 September 30 column reports Treasury bills $1,693,595,956, government money-market funds $451,826,457 and cash deposits $378,585,861, summing exactly to $2,524,008,274 against 2,399,995,528 outstanding RLUSD. The September 30 column alone supplies this composition; the September 21 column is not blended. Stable row keys match the hash-bound producer. Depository and fund identities remain undisclosed.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Deloitte examination of the RLUSD Reserve Report as of September 30, 2026 at 5:00pm Eastern Time
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No material asset-class exposure is unclassified; the public report does not identify the depository institutions, money market funds, or custodians.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Ripple's July 9, 2025 press release names BNY as the primary RLUSD reserve custodian, and the Deloitte report plus stablecoin terms confirm segregated reserve accounts held with NYDFS-approved U.S. depositories or custodians. Custody allocation shares, the identities of any additional depository institutions, statutory bankruptcy remoteness, and reserve-wide rehypothecation treatment remain undisclosed.
